summary: Although slavery was prevalent in the British colonies, different regions participated in the practice to varying extents. The plantation based economies of the Southern colonies had the most slaves, while they were prominent within New England. New laws were also established to create a strict racial system within the colonies, which Africans developed modes of resistance to.
